channel.title: Weatherman Walking
channel.desc: Derek is island hopping in this round-up of his favourite Welsh island walks. He goes wild in west Wales as he sails to Skomer Island - a national nature reserve of international importance due to its seabirds - where he gets a close-up view of the puffins, razorbills and guillemots before staying up late to see the Manx shearwater. Next, Derek goes to Flat Holm Island where he braves a huge colony of seagulls and discovers more about the island's past, including some Victorian gun placements.
